blocks.content: Time to make your moles clickable! You'll add an event listener to each mole that listens for clicks.
For now, you'll just test it by logging a message to the console when a mole is clicked. Later, you'll make the mole disappear.

items: Inside the for loop that creates holes and moles, add an event listener to each mole that listens for "click" events.

blocks.content: When a mole is clicked, log "Mole clicked!" to the console.
